Reconstructed the Urdu body of [قرآنِ کربلا](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/2/workspaces/5d705455fb40467f890aca1c4e90e64e/src/data/lyrics/qraan-karbala.md) and verified that all 83 verse lines correspond in order to the transcription in `romanLyrics`. Set the direction to RTL, added the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read the ambiguous `Sin ape` as `سناں پہ`, `Sina kin ok` as `سناں کی نوک`, and `Tumhafra` as `تمہارا`.
